content.text:
I opened PR **[#82](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/82)** in pi-action and issue **[cv/pit#372](https://github.com/cv/pit/issues/372)** for pit. pi-durable is unchanged, and `npm run check` passes.

**pi-action (#82)**
- **The new field:** a tool from a pi-durable extension can now have an optional `present` field. Since pi-durable doesn't declare it, pi-action reads it as unknown and checks what it returns. The checks are in a new file, `src/tool-presentation.ts`.
  - `present.call(args)` returns `{ title, body? }`: the `🔧` line, and the details shown in place of the arguments.
  - `present.result(args, result)` returns `{ summary?, body? }`: the text that replaces "N lines" on the `↳` line, and the details shown in place of the output. `result` includes the stored `details`, so a tool can pass data from `execute()` to `result()`.
- **Fallback:** anything a tool leaves out uses the current rendering. If a function throws, returns a promise or returns the wrong types, the log shows the current rendering and one `⚠️` line per tool and function.
- **Limits stay the same:** 120-character lines, 4000 characters of arguments, and the last 30 lines of output. Workflow commands in the text are still blocked.
- **Wiring:** in `src/run.ts`, `Activity.useTools()` gets the tools of the loaded extensions. A tool that replaces another with the same name also replaces its `present`.
- **The `// @pit:` parsing from #81 stays** as the fallback for now. Removing it needs a pit release with `present`, pinned in `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`. That's a separate small PR after this one.
- **Docs:** a new section, "Show tool calls in the workflow log", in `docs/extensions.md`; a pointer to it in the `🔧` and `↳` rows of `docs/how-it-works.md`; and a row for the new file in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

**pit (#372)** describes the field and what the `typescript` tool could return:
- **When the call starts:** the label from the header as the line, and the code without the header, plus `params` as indented JSON, in the details.
- **When it ends:** the functions the program used (`workspace.read · git.status`) on the `↳` line, or the first line of the error on failure. The details would show the returned value as readable text instead of escaped JSON.

The issue links to the docs section on `main`, so that link only works once #82 is merged. I couldn't add a link to #82 on the pit issue, because this token isn't allowed to comment on `cv/pit`. The issue body does link #80.
